summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandmother (via the probable Frank-Giovanni link); styled 'Donna' at Dasà.
bio: Tree: 'Mariantonia' Cannatello (b. 1816). MyHeritage index: Mariangiola Cognetta née Cannatello, b. 1818 Dasà, wife of Nicola Cognetta. Birth act of Giovanni (1855): 'Donna Mariangela Cannatello', 32 (b. c.1823). So three birth-year values: 1816 (tree), 1818 (MyHeritage), c.1823 (age in 1855 act - preferred as primary, though ages in acts can be approximate). The tree's given name 'Mariantonia' is wrong. paese.app: Cannatello's only Calabrian US arrival came from Sorianello, in the same district.
